minor.issue: Universal EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exhausted mid-run (Max budget: 1.0). All AI endpoints now return 502 — surfaced as `AI request failed: litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded!`. Add budget-exceeded → HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` and a friendlier error string so the frontend can display a proper toast instead of a generic 502.

N+1 query pattern: for each of up to 500 aggregated customers, _aggregate_customers issues 1 loyalty_members.find_one + a store_credits.find cursor. With 264 rows the /customers page took ~2s. Consider one $lookup or two batched find({customer:{$in:[...]}}).
amount is a float — allows fractional cents (e.g. 42.123456). Should quantize to 2 decimals server-side.

integration_issues.flow: Today's Promo widget / Calendar generate / One-Click modal / Segment Promo
integration_issues.issue: All four UI paths downstream of budget-exhausted /api/ai/* endpoints show no user-friendly error state — the pages just sit in a busy spinner or silently fail; there is no data-testid=ai-error surface. Recommend: catch 5xx/BadRequest from AI endpoints and render a visible 'AI is temporarily unavailable' banner.

issues: Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart parent lacks explicit minHeight so initial render logs warnings before ResizeObserver settles.

segment-promo-btn is intentionally hidden until a non-'all' filter is selected — this is not documented in the review_request expectation, mention to future testers: click segment-vip/frequent/regular/new/at_risk chip first.

action_items: TOP UP or rotate EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — universal key is over-budget ($1.006 vs $1.0). Until then every /api/ai/* endpoint returns 502.
Wrap AI HTTPException(502) to emit HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` for LiteLLM BadRequestError containing 'Budget'.
Add a client-side error toast on all 4 AI UI flows (Today's Promo, Weekly Calendar, One-Click, Segment Promo) — currently they hang on 502.
OPTIONAL: batch queries in _aggregate_customers to reduce Mongo round-trips (N+1).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1752 lines — well past the 700-line split threshold. Recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, coupons, public, ai, growth, loyalty, gift_cards, journeys, customers, api_keys, templates) before iter 5.

gen_qr(code) is called on every POST /api/coupons and one-click approve — the QR is stored inline as base64 in Mongo, inflating document size ~2-4KB per coupon. Consider generating on GET or storing a URL.
_aggregate_customers awaits an async cursor for store_credits per customer inside a for-loop — O(N) round-trips. Use aggregate with $lookup.

API-keys: key is bcrypt-hashed on create but there is no verify_api_key middleware to actually authenticate downstream `pk_live_` requests. Endpoint exists to mint/revoke keys but no route currently accepts them for auth — the 'Public REST API' promise is not yet enforced.

public_wallet resolves the workspace_id from the FIRST record found across gift_cards/credits/loyalty/redemptions. If a customer email exists in multiple workspaces (multi-tenant), the returned workspace_name is deterministic but arbitrary. Consider requiring workspace_id query param or scoping via signed token.

AutopilotConfigIn.max_discount is int but _guardrail_discount coerces via float(v) — the model should validate range (e.g., 1<=max_discount<=90). Currently negative/zero are accepted and get max(1, ...) at guardrail time.
customer identifier is still plain text (email/UUID). PII in redemptions/loyalty/store_credits/gift_cards untouched — same iter-3 concern.
gift_cards issue does NOT enforce max amount cap. A single call could issue $999,999. Add server-side max or role gate.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the late-run AI 502s: the shared EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (universal key) is configured with a $1.00 max budget, and this iteration's backend pytest ran ~10 Claude sonnet-5 calls (todays-promo, weekly-calendar x1, one-click x2, segment-promo x1) plus prior iterations' AI experiments already consumed the balance. Current spend at test-finish time: $1.006. Reproduction: `curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/api/ai/segment-promo -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"segment":"vip"}'` returns `{"detail":"AI request failed: Failed to generate chat completion: litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 1.00636275, Max budget: 1.0"}`. Mitigation: (1) Top up / rotate EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (Emergent-internal action). (2) Backend should catch litellm.BadRequestError with 'Budget' in the message and return 429 + Retry-After so the UI can display a proper toast instead of a generic 502. (3) Consider caching AI outputs (todays-promo is deterministic per day per workspace — a 24h Redis/mongo cache would eliminate 90% of spend).
